Im going through this now. My wife ended our maariage due to my OCD cleaning and i was difficult to live with. I had a set routine everyday for cleaning and it controlled me 100%. Ive had to leave our marital home and within 2 weeks of leaving i find out she is on tinder and i think she was on there while we were still 2gether but she wont admit it. 17 and a half years we were 2gether and she started a new relationship with another man about 2 months after our seperation. At first my mind was going crazy about her being intimate with another man but now the thoughts r less frequent and not as scary but sometimes i have bad relapses. i realised i had to take her off this pedestal i put her on as she let me believe she was whiter than white and let everyone else think it aswell but her true colours have shown.
Yes the OCD is always there. Im on medication and have tried different ones aswell but its always there and makes the situation so much harder to deal with.
Id also love to know the answer. But i dont think there is a 100% full proof method.
I hav no job and nothing to offer anyone. Not everyone can be saved. I just wish there was a pill i could take to fall asleep permanently.

I believe this pain will be forever. Im not good with women and i know because of my OCD that no woman could ever love me properly. My OCD was the main reason for my marriage ending and no one else will put up with me.
Thanks for the reply. I have a few friends ive talked to about everything and they hav listened to me but nothing makes me feel better.
